title: Products never ordered
statementMd:
Find products that appear in **no** order.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)` is one approach.
`NOT EXISTS` or a `LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL` also work.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items);
```

The subquery lists every ordered product id; `NOT IN` keeps the rest. Beware: `NOT IN` returns nothing if the subquery contains NULLs, which is why `NOT EXISTS` is often safer.

expected.query: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items);
